tocca_vincitore_partita_si_salva: Tap the winner: the game is saved and you go back Home.
senza_vincitore_partita_non_entra: Without a winner the game stays in the list but is not counted in the statistics.
hai_una_partita_iniziata_date: You have a game started on {{date}} at {{time}} that was never saved ({{players}}). Resume where you left off?
mazzi_precostruiti_qualsiasi_mazzo_salva: Precon decks or any deck saved in MTG Tracker
carte_non_riconosciute_sistemale_in_one: {{count}} unresolved card: fix it in MTG Tracker before playing.
carte_non_riconosciute_sistemale_in_othe: {{count}} unresolved cards: fix them in MTG Tracker before playing.
questo_mazzo_cambiato_mentre_stavi: This deck changed while you were reviewing it. Review the updated cards and confirm again.
supabase_non_configurato_variabili_manca: Supabase is not configured (missing VITE_SUPABASE_URL / VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY variables).
account_sua_email_vengono_cancellati: Your account and its email are deleted for good. The games you saved stay in the group's history; for your decks, you choose.
restano_nell_elenco_nelle_statistiche: They stay in the list and in the statistics, with no owner: anyone with an account can edit them.
spariscono_dall_elenco_dalle_statistiche: They disappear from the list and from everyone's card statistics. Games already played still show their names. To keep them, export them first from each deck's page.
partite_che_hai_salvato_one: The games you saved ({{count}} game) stay in the group's history, with no owner. Your player name and the groups you created stay too.
partite_che_hai_salvato_other: The games you saved ({{count}} games) stay in the group's history, with no owner. Your player name and the groups you created stay too.
link_scaduto_gia_stato_usato: The link has expired or was already used. Enter your email to get a new one.
troppe_richieste_ravvicinate_aspetta_un: Too many requests in a row: wait a minute and try again.
se_indirizzo_registrato_riceverai_breve: If the address is registered, you'll soon get an email with a link to choose a new password. Check your spam folder too.
account_creato_controlla_tua_email: Account created. Check your email to confirm it, then sign in.
scegli_nuova_password_per_tuo: Choose a new password for your account
accedi_con_tuo_account_per: Sign in with your account to continue
crea_un_account_per_iniziare: Create an account to get started
ti_mando_un_link_per: I'll send you a link to choose a new password
non_hai_un_account_registrati: Don't have an account? Sign up
hai_gia_un_account_accedi: Already have an account? Sign in
vai_zaff_piattaforma_di_gioco: Go to ZAFF, the game platform →
password_deve_avere_almeno: The password must be at least {{min}} characters long.
tocca_carta_per_usarla_al: Tap the card to use it instead of the unresolved one
ricerca_non_riuscita_controlla_connessio: Search failed: check your connection and try again.
scrivi_almeno_lettere_tocca_una: Type at least 2 letters. Tap a card to see it large.
nessuna_carta_trovata_con_questo: No card found with this name.
nel_mazzo_tocca_carta: In the deck: {{count}} · tap the card to add one
